# Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 85 (Bi-Vb Pc85)

**ID:** Bi-Vb Pc85  
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)

**Title (English, from literature):** Traveling in a vehicle  
**tipitaka.org (CST):** [https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul7.xml](https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul7.xml)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Yāna Sikkhāpada* ("Rule on traveling in a vehicle"), designated as Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 85, is an expiation rule within the Theravāda Vinaya Piṭaka. The rule stipulates that a nun who rides or travels in a vehicle commits an offence requiring confession (*pācittiya*). The text is translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

 It corresponds directly to the Theravāda Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha (*pli-tv-bi-pm-pc85*), Bhikkhunī Parivāra Pācittiya 85, and relates to Khandhaka 20 (Bhikkhunikkhandhaka). Cross-tradition parallels include the Dharmaguptaka (*Lzh Dg Bi Vb Pc 159*), Mahīśāsaka (*Lzh Mi Bi Vb Pc 141*), Sarvāstivāda (*Lzh Sarv Bi Vb Pc 145*), Mūlasarvāstivāda (Chinese *Lzh Mu Bi Vb Pc 158* and Tibetan *xct-mu-bi-vb-pc132*), and Mahāsaṅghika-Lokottaravāda (Chinese *Lzh Mg Bi Vb Pc 111* and Sanskrit *san-lo-bi-vb-pc111*).

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog data.*
